none.comment: Flat surfaces. Prefer over removing the property entirely.

xs.comment: Resting state for dense lists and inline controls. Navy-tinted stop (plan V2 §2.6: all shadow stops are navy rgba(15, 27, 51, …), never slate).

sm.comment: Matches the legacy --shadow-sm already used by inputs, cards and popovers.

card.comment: Resting elevation for cards and panels that sit directly on the tinted page ground. Ledger rule (plan V2 §2.6): hairline border + whisper shadow, navy-tinted stops (was slate-tinted).

md.comment: Default card shadow. Identical to the current AnimatedCard shadow.

lg.comment: Hover and raised state. Identical to the current card hover shadow.

inner.comment: Inset wells such as disabled or read-only inputs. Navy-tinted stop (plan V2 §2.6).

focus.comment: Keyboard focus ring. Pair with color.border.focus. Midnight Ledger (plan V2 §2.6): primary navy rgba(29, 50, 96, .35) — replaces the legacy blue rgba(37, 99, 235, .35) that survived P0. One shared value serves both themes (shadow.json is theme-agnostic); in dark the ring's visibility is carried by the gold border/focus colour it pairs with.
